critique.reason: The Steel Mobile Workstation (GT7218) is a free-standing metal assembly comprising a steel chassis, locking steel cabinets/drawers, an overhead hutch, a rubberwood worksurface, and a pegboard. As a complete article of metal furniture not of a kind used in offices, it falls under 9403.20.00. It is not household furniture (LEVEL 2 alternative), so 'Other' applies. At LEVEL 3 it is a combination of lockers/cabinets, shelves, and racks — squarely within 'Counters, lockers, racks, display cases, shelves, partitions and similar fixtures'. At LEVEL 4 it is not boltless/press-fit shelving (stat note 4), not a storage locker (stat note 5), and not the residual 'Steel racks' breakout 9403.20.00.82 (which covers other steel racks not elsewhere specified), so the residual 'Other' (9403.20.00.86) correctly applies.

critique.reason: The product is a stamped (implied from prior rulings) 5-ply clad metal disc of stainless steel and aluminum alloys, 55% stainless steel by weight, 300 mm diameter, 3 mm thick, for use as a cookware blank. It is an article of iron or steel (Chapter 73). It is not forged/stamped and not further worked (7326.20 covers articles thereof, but this is a multi-layer clad disc, not simple stamping). It is not of tinplate (7326.90.10), not brake cable (7326.90.25), not pocket containers (7326.90.35), not horseshoes (7326.90.45), not precious metal coated (7326.90.60). At 7326.90.86 it is not grounding rods, not adhesive-laminated flat-rolled sheets with non-metallic core (7326.90.86.10) — this is metallurgically bonded clad metal with metallic aluminum core — nor any of the other specific alternatives. Therefore it falls under the residual 7326.90.86.88. Prior ruling N324349 confirms this classification for identical goods.
